Nov 20, 2025

Another member joins our team. Alex Ferrier joined in November as a researcher, focusing on the development of positive P and truncated Wigner methods for spin lattices, as well as on preparing and adjusting our codes for broader use.

This project is funded by the European Union under Horizon Europe (project No. 101186579).
